description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
Delete multiple words from your Dictionary

Clean up multiple words in your Dictionary in one go, making regular maintenance quicker as your Dictionary grows.
From any view or search result, hover over a word and click the checkbox to start selecting, then continue choosing and deleting words in the same place.
Thanks for using Typeless. We hope your Dictionary stays easy to manage as it grows.
